en.html:
...Yes.
Finished.

The devil-shaped tsurugi, still separated, fell toward the ground.
Falling. Not a controlled descent.

Every last bit of heat was spent.
Gattari barrels, wings—all mere iron now.

Ordinary physical law had taken charge. Down they went.
They could not save themselves. Neither could I save them. Reach from here as I might, I could not reach far enough.

ja.html:
……そう。
　終わりだった。

　悪魔を模す騎体は、ばらばらのまま、地を目指して
墜落してゆく。
　……墜落、だった。降下ではない。

　熱量を全て使い果たしたのだ。
　<ruby>合当理<rt>バレル</rt></ruby>も、<ruby>翼甲<rt>ウイング</rt></ruby>も、こうなっては只の鉄に過ぎない。

　彼らは単純な物理法則に支配され、落ちてゆく。
　彼らは自身を救えない。俺も、救うことはできない。
ここからどう手を伸ばそうと届かない。

en.html:
I nodded. Still, I could not leave.

Something would not settle inside me.
Try as I might, it would not settle.

What had these people been?

With that question unanswered, I watched the four tsurugi falling to their end.
My eyes fixed on one.
